Identifying and Mitigating Technical and Schedule Risk
Organizational Chart and Key Personnel Resumes

requirements.text: Volume I, Technical, shall not exceed 25 pages.
Volume II, Management, shall not exceed 15 pages.
Pages shall be 8.5 x 11 inches with 1-inch margins.
Text shall be Times New Roman 12 point.
Text in tables and graphics shall be no smaller than 10 point.
The offeror shall describe its technical approach to SOW tasks 3.1 through 3.4.
The offeror shall describe its approach to identifying and mitigating technical and schedule risk.
The offeror shall provide an organizational chart and resumes for key personnel.
Resumes are excluded from the page count and shall not exceed two pages each.
The Government will evaluate the 30-page technical volume for understanding of the requirement and feasibility of approach.

questions_for_co.question: L.3.1 limits Volume I, Technical, to 25 pages, while M.3 refers to a 30-page technical volume. Which page limit applies to Volume I?
L.5.1 does not state which volume the organizational chart and key personnel resumes belong in. Should they be submitted in Volume II, Management?
Is the L.5.1 exclusion of resumes from the page count limited to the volume containing them, and does it apply to the organizational chart?
Does M.3's evaluation for understanding of the requirement and feasibility of approach apply to both Subfactor 1a and Subfactor 1b, and what criteria apply to Factor 2, Management, and Price?
L.2 refers to a designated portal. Please identify the portal and any registration requirements.
